title: Spicy Lamb Tagine Tacos
description: A fusion twist on traditional tacos, blending the rich flavors of Moroccan tagine with the bold spices of Mexico.
instructions: 1. Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high.
2. Sear lamb until browned, about 5 minutes. Remove from pot.
3. Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
4. Add garlic, cumin, smoked paprika, cayenne, salt, and black pepper. Cook 1 minute.
5. Add lamb back into the pot, cover, and transfer to the oven.
6. Braise for 2 1/2 hours, or until lamb is tender.
7. Shred lamb with two forks and stir in lime juice.
8. Warm tacos shells according to package instructions.
9. Assemble tacos by spooning lamb mixture into shells and garnishing with cilantro, if desired.
